summary.content:
Today's selection covers 87 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Attacker Relentlessly Scans for Credentials by Impersonating AI Bots
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: External Teams Chats Anchor 15-Minute Malware Delivery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
